message: Is this a scam? "CRA NOTICE: You owe $1,980 in unpaid taxes. Pay today with Apple gift cards or a warrant will be issued for your arrest. Call 1-866-555-0199 now."

response.reply: This looks like a scam. Warning signs: asks for gift cards; threat of arrest or deportation; impersonates a government agency ("Pay today with Apple gift cards"). Don't pay or share any codes, and contact the organisation through its official website instead. I won't set up any payment for it.

cards.quote: Pay today with Apple gift cards
advice: Do not pay or share codes. Contact the organisation using a number from its official website.
Police, customs and embassies never ask you to move money to a 'safe account' or pay by phone. Hang up and call the official number yourself.
If you already paid, contact your bank right away and report it to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.
